hints.text: This clue's indicator is 'Agitate', and it's an anagram indicator. We'll agitate and mix up some neighbouring letters to form our answer.
This clue's fodder is 'unload, dry'. We'll use these letters to construct our answer, as guided by the clue's indicator(s).

This is an &lit clue, which means that the whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay. We used to signify our &lits with the !? punctuation, but from here on out, it'll be just an exclamation point. In this clue, our answer will be something to do with a process involving agitating, unloading and drying.
